# LOAD DATA section:
  - loads the preprocessed data and tidies it up into a polished "data" data frame

  depending on the differences in file names, etc.
  
  - first, MAKE SURE the current directory is up-to-date
  and corresponds to the project folder, which has a data folder.
  Adjust the file name and the script will automatically load the data from this folder.

## Elevated Plus Maze (EPM)

### Experimental conditions

2 groups of mice:

LOG DATA: _No Crash of the system, all data can be used_

-> all data can be used    

Path to all Raw data files: `~\6. Data from Behavioral Test\analysis\EPM`  

Preprocessed Data: 
 
2 groups:  

`EPM_data_pm_2025-02-03.xlsx`    
`EPM_data_wt_2025-02-03.xlsx`   

The analysis of the data is done in this Rmd file directly.  

Path to Report: `~\6. Data from Behavioral Test\EPM`    

### Data Quality:  
->All data can be used. 

```{r OP_data_loading}

rm(list = ls())

### 1.0 LOAD IN DATA ----------------------------------------------------------
# Load cohort 1 data
file_path <- "~/6. Data from Behavioral Tests/analysis/EPM/"

raw_data_file_pm <- "EPM_data_pm_2025-02-03.xlsx"
raw_data_file_wt <- "EPM_data_wt_2025-02-03.xlsx"

data_pm <- read_excel(paste(file_path,raw_data_file_pm,sep=""))
data_wt <- read_excel(paste(file_path,raw_data_file_wt,sep=""))

# combine all groups to create a single data frame 
raw_data <- rbind(data_pm, data_wt)

#get list of strains without NAs
list_of_genotypes <- sort(na.omit(unique(raw_data$genotype)), decreasing = T)

# select relevant data columns
data <- raw_data %>%
  # Select relevant columns
  dplyr::select(no, animal_no, cohort, genotype, gender, contains("Tracklength"), contains("Track length"), contains("Track_length"), contains("Visits"), contains("Visit"), contains("Duration")) 

#names(data)

#lapply(data,class)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(genotype = factor(genotype),
         gender = factor(gender)) %>%
  mutate_at(c(6:34),as.numeric)

```

\newpage

### Analysis of the data

#### Distance travelled in open and closed arms

```{r fig1, fig.align = "left", fig.width=9, fig.height=9}

# data fig1
data_f1 <- data %>%
  filter(no == "Sum") %>%
  mutate(open_distsum = `Tracklength (cm) E open` + `Tracklength (cm) W open`,
         closed_distsum = `Tracklength (cm) N closed` + `Tracklength (cm) S closed`)

################################# 

## fig1a: open_distsum
# stats
stat_1a <- data_f1 %>%
  wilcox_test(open_distsum ~ genotype) %>%
  add_significance("p")

# fig
pl_1a = data_f1 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = genotype, y = open_distsum, color = genotype, label = "")) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_point(#aes(colour = factor(genotype), shape=genotype), size = 1, 
             position = position_jitter(w=0.1), 
             show.legend = FALSE) + 
  
  # Labels & layout
  geom_text(hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.05) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(40,400)) +
  labs(title="Distance travelled in open arms", 
       x="", 
       y = "Distance (cm)") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  #add 'n='
  stat_n_text() +
#  stat_n_text(y.pos = 5000) +  
  #legend
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) 

#pl_1a  

# significance
stat_1a <- stat_1a %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "genotype", dodge = 0.8)
fig1a <-  pl_1a +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_1a,  label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02
    )
#    y.position = 5
#    )

#fig1a

################################# 
 
## fig1b: open_distsum genderwise
# stats
stat_1b <- data_f1 %>%
  group_by(genotype) %>%
  wilcox_test(open_distsum ~ gender) %>%
  add_significance("p")

# fig
pl_1b = data_f1 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = genotype, y = open_distsum, color = gender, label = "")) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_point(#aes(colour = factor(genotype), shape=genotype), size = 1, 
             position = position_jitter(w=0.1), 
             show.legend = FALSE) + 
  
  # Labels & layout
  geom_text(hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.05) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(40,400)) +
  labs(title="Distance travelled in open arms", 
       x="", 
       y = "Distance (cm)") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  #add 'n='
  stat_n_text() +
#  stat_n_text(y.pos = 5000) + 
  geom_text(aes(y = after_stat(count), label=after_stat(count)), stat="count", y=40, position = position_dodge(width = 0.95,), size=4, show.legend = FALSE) + 
  #legend
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) 

#pl_1b  

# significance
stat_1b <- stat_1b %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "genotype", dodge = 0.8)
fig1b <-  pl_1b +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_1b,  label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02
    )
#    y.position = 5
#    )

#fig1b
  
################################# 

## fig1c: closed_distsum
# stats

  wilcox_test(closed_distsum ~ genotype) %>%
  add_significance("p")

# fig

  labs(title="Distance travelled in closed arms", 
       x="",

  theme_classic() +

#pl_1c

# significance

fig1c <-  pl_1c +

################################# 
  
## fig1d: closed_distsum genderwise

#  stat_n_text(y.pos = 5000) +  
  geom_text(aes(y = after_stat(count), label=after_stat(count)), stat="count", y=560, position = position_dodge(width = 0.95,), size=4, show.legend = FALSE) + 
  #legend
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) 

#pl_1d

# significance
stat_1d <- stat_1d %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "genotype", dodge = 0.8)
fig1d <-  pl_1d +

################################# 

#arrange plots into a grid with automatic sublabels (A,B)
fig1 <- ggarrange(fig1a, fig1b, fig1c, fig1d, labels="AUTO", ncol=2, nrow=2, common.legend=FALSE, legend = "bottom") 

fig1

```

__Figure 1.__ Distance traveled (cm) in open arms between groups (A) and between gender within group (B), and in closed arms between groups (C) and between gender within group (D).

#### Percentage time spent in open and closed arms

```{r fig2, fig.align = "left", fig.width=9, fig.height=9}

# data fig2
data_f2 <- data %>%
  filter(no == "Sum") %>%
  mutate(open_perc = 100*((`Duration (s) E open` + `Duration (s) W open`)/(`Duration (s) E open` + `Duration (s) W open` + `Duration (s) N closed` + `Duration (s) S closed` + `Duration (s) Center zone`)),
         closed_perc = 100*((`Duration (s) N closed` + `Duration (s) S closed`)/(`Duration (s) E open` + `Duration (s) W open` + `Duration (s) N closed` + `Duration (s) S closed` + `Duration (s) Center zone`)))

################################# 

## fig2a: open_perc

  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(6,32)) +
  labs(title="Percentage time spent in open arms", 
       x="", 
       y = "Percentage") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  #add 'n='
#  stat_n_text() +
  stat_n_text(y.pos = 6) +  
  #legend
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",

  geom_text(aes(y = after_stat(count), label=after_stat(count)), stat="count", y=3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.95,), size=4, show.legend = FALSE) + 
  #legend
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) 

#pl_3b  

# significance
stat_3b <- stat_3b %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "genotype", dodge = 0.8)
fig3b <-  pl_3b +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_3b,  label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02
    )
#    y.position = 5
#    )

#fig3b
  
################################# 

## fig3c: closed_entries
# stats
stat_3c <- data_f3 %>%
  wilcox_test(closed_entries ~ genotype) %>%
  add_significance("p")

# fig
pl_3c = data_f3 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = genotype, y = closed_entries, color = genotype, label = "")) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_point(#aes(colour = factor(genotype), shape=genotype), size = 1, 
             position = position_jitter(w=0.1), 
             show.legend = FALSE) + 
  
  # Labels & layout
  geom_text(hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.05) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(5,22)) +
  labs(title="Percentage time spent in closed arms", 
       x="", 
       y = "Percentage") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  #add 'n='
  stat_n_text() +
#  stat_n_text(y.pos = 45) +  
  #legend
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) 

#pl_3c

# significance
stat_3c <- stat_3c %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "genotype", dodge = 0.8)
fig3c <-  pl_3c +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_3c,  label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02
    )
#    y.position = 5
#    )

#fig3c

################################# 
  
## fig3d: closed_entries genderwise 
# stats
stat_3d <- data_f3 %>%
  group_by(genotype) %>%
  wilcox_test(closed_entries ~ gender) %>%
  add_significance("p")

# fig
pl_3d = data_f3 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = genotype, y = closed_entries, color = gender, label = "")) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_point(#aes(colour = factor(genotype), shape=genotype), size = 1, 
             position = position_jitter(w=0.1), 
             show.legend = FALSE) + 
  
  # Labels & layout
  geom_text(hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.05) +
#  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(45,85)) +
  labs(title="Percentage time spent in closed arms", 
       x="", 
       y = "Percentage") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  #add 'n='
#  stat_n_text() +
  stat_n_text(y.pos = 5) +  
  geom_text(aes(y = after_stat(count), label=after_stat(count)), stat="count", y=5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.95,), size=4, show.legend = FALSE) + 
  #legend
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) 

#pl_3d

# significance
stat_3d <- stat_3d %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "genotype", dodge = 0.8)
fig3d <-  pl_3d +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_3d,  label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02
    )
#    y.position = 5
#    )

#fig3d

################################# 

#arrange plots into a grid with automatic sublabels (A,B)
fig3 <- ggarrange(fig3a, fig3b, fig3c, fig3d, labels="AUTO", ncol=2, nrow=2, common.legend=FALSE, legend = "bottom") 

fig3

```
